audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. The full layer calls Abscond/Abduct a 'dash into chain-stun' in three places, and the page treats Hijack as generic 'ult-theft' without ever saying what he steals in this matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text for Abscond is a dash with a recast that throws chains and pulls Sylas to an enemy he hits — it is a pull toward the target, not a stun on you. And Hijack steals the enemy's ultimate: against Locke that is Purgatory, so at rank 3 he has your own execute available every 30 seconds. That is the single most important fact in the lane after first item and it never appears. Locke's R also grounds, which shuts off both of Sylas's dashes — Kingslayer's lunge and the Abduct chain.
audit.corrected: Chain-stun replaced with the dash-then-pull and its 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown; Hijack stated as stealing Purgatory specifically; the grounding-versus-two-dashes interaction added to late.

audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is correctly the tracked cooldown; the number was missing and is now written into breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Sylas scales into a slippery skirmisher who steals a game-changing ult in fights — the 1v1 lane matters less than his roam and ult-theft value.
edits.after: Sylas scales into a slippery skirmisher whose Hijack reaches 30 seconds at rank 3 — he steals Purgatory and executes you with your own ultimate.

edits.before: At 6 you spike: R (Purgatory) executes a low Sylas before his W (Kingslayer) heal saves him, and you avoid feeding a strong ult-steal. After first item your burst wins the race, but if he scales he becomes a slippery ult-thief in teamfights, so late the lane evens out.
edits.after: At 6 you spike: R (Purgatory) grounds, killing both his Kingslayer lunge and his Abduct chain, and executes a low Sylas before the heal saves him. After first item your burst wins the race, but as he scales he Hijacks that same ult in fights, so late the lane evens out.

edits.before: Scale and roam, stealing a high-impact ult in the next fight
edits.after: Hijack your Purgatory and execute you with your own ult

notes: Abscond/Abduct is a dash whose recast throws a chain that pulls SYLAS to you — the page called it a chain-stun in three full-layer fields. The larger gap: Hijack steals the enemy ultimate, so against Locke he holds Purgatory, and at rank 3 that is every 30 seconds. The page only ever said 'ult-theft' generically. Locke's R grounding shuts off both of Sylas's dashes, which is the concrete reason to hold it for his commit rather than open with it.
